query: need 12 of the 3/4-10 x 3 inch lag screw in 18-8, black oxide
rationale: Lag screws carry a length on all 97 SKUs (profile), and 3/4 at 3 inch is a single active group; 18-8 SS black oxide confirms it. The quantity phrase is noise.

query: M6-1.0 x 25mm phillips pan machine screw, A2 stainless, zinc
rationale: M6 pan machine screw at 25 mm is a single active group and A2 SS zinc matches it. The query spells the type in full, the longest of the eight PAN phrase variants in the profile.

query: 5/8-11 x 1 socket head cap screw alloy mech zinc
rationale: 5/8 socket head cap screw at 1 inch is a single active group; alloy mech zinc matches. The inch mark is left off, a form the profile records on the catalog side too.

query: M8-1.25 x 40mm tap bolt, alloy, zinc plated
rationale: M8 tap bolt at 40 mm is a single active group. "zinc plated" is a distributor synonym for the ZINC finish, whose only catalog surface forms are ZINC and ZN.

query: #8-32 x 5/8 tap bolt hot dip galvanised 18-8
rationale: #8 tap bolt at 5/8 inch is a single active group. HDG is the only surface form of that finish in the catalog, so the words the customer uses never appear in the description.

query: 316 stainless M10 x 30 mm socket head cap screw, zinc
rationale: M10 socket head cap screw at 30 mm is a single active group. Material leads the query and a space separates length from unit; both are order and form variations, not new constraints.

query: what do you have for mounting a bracket to concrete
rationale: Neither a diameter nor a type is recognizable, so there is no constraint to build a compatible set from. docs/DESIGN.md 5.3 makes this unparsed rather than none.

query: 1/2-13 x 1-1/4" socket head cap screw 316 ss hot dipped
rationale: 1/2 socket head cap screw at 1-1/4 inch is a single active group. The inch mark is written out here and "hot dipped" is HDG.

query: M10 lock washer
rationale: Lock washers carry no length in the catalog (0 of 91 in the profile), so diameter and type leave five active SKUs differing only in material, finish and standard.

query: 3/4 hex nuts please
rationale: Nuts carry no length (0 of 86 in the profile); 3/4 leaves six active hex nuts. The closing courtesy is noise.

query: 7/16 flat washer
rationale: Washers carry no length (0 of 101 in the profile); 7/16 leaves four active flat washers.

query: M12 hex nut to ISO 7380
rationale: A standard constrains only when the query names it. Diameter and type alone leave nine active M12 hex nuts; exactly one carries ISO 7380, so the explicit standard resolves the tie.

query: 7/8-9 hex nut
rationale: 7/8 is not one of the sixteen catalog diameters, so the compatible set is empty and the diameter is the failed constraint.

query: square head set screw M6
rationale: A set screw is not one of the ten catalog types. The diameter does parse, so docs/DESIGN.md 5.3 puts this at none rather than unparsed.

query: M12 x 95mm tap bolt
rationale: M12 tap bolts exist at 10, 12, 20, 25, 40, 50, 60 and 80 mm. 95 mm is not among them, so the length is the failed constraint.

query: M16-2.0 x 8mm socket head cap screw A2 yellow zinc
rationale: The only SKU with these attributes, PXSOC168A2YZ0034, is inactive, and docs/DESIGN.md 3.1 keeps inactive SKUs out of the compatible set. The right answer is none plus a discontinued note, not a match.

query: M10 hex cap screw 25mm with a nylon patch
rationale: "nylon patch" is residue with no catalog attribute behind it. M10 hex cap screw at 25 mm is a single active group, so the residue must not remove the match.

query: lcok washer M12 allow black oxide
rationale: Two typos, one in the type phrase and one in the material. M12 lock washer in alloy black oxide is a single active SKU.

query: send the flat washers we had on the last order
rationale: CUST-002 bought flat washers on 2026-04-15, 2026-02-18 and 2025-08-15. docs/DESIGN.md 7.4 makes a pure reference status history with the referenced lines ranked by recency. The wording is an ordinary paraphrase rather than one of the phrases the design quotes, which is what makes it a held-out case.

query: same hex nuts as our last order, but hot dip galvanised
rationale: The most recent CUST-004 hex nut line is the 1/2-13 alloy black oxide nut of 2026-02-12. Under docs/DESIGN.md 7.4 that line is the base specification and the explicit finish overwrites it; the merged specification has exactly one active match, so the status comes from the compatible set and not from the reference.
